profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: MES Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Leveraged message processing performance by refactoring ~170 Spring-based messaging logic components to utilize Prototype scope and Asynchronous (@Async) execution patterns, eliminating thread blocking and resource contention.
2. Utilized Spring Cloud Eureka to identify active backend instances, leveraging Solace's advanced queuing mechanisms to ensure reliable traffic routing and priority-based message distribution.
3. Built automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Jenkins to streamline application updates and maintain high availability across backend services.
4. Engineered real-time WIP/lot tracking dashboards with integrated MS Teams/Outlook alerts, processing 30,000+ weekly data points to minimize data latency and maintain system integrity.
5. Developed full-stack MES management tools using Java and Vue.js, embedding complex Oracle SQL queries with PIVOT transformations and custom stored procedures/functions to transform raw data into actionable manufacturing metrics.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Web Development · Vue.js · Multithreading · Semiconductor MES

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Optimized sequential shared memory retrieval and storage with multithreading, improving data accuracy by 3.7%.
- Ensured secured data message exchange over TCP/IP socket networking between semiconductor equipment and host in C#/C++.
- Architect a JSON file comparison tool in C# for 2,000+ users, utilizing a tree structure, dictionary, and MVVM pattern.
- Enabled inter-process communication for 10,000+ IO value requests, updates, and process execution using mail slots.
- Worked in Agile methodology and CI/CD, overseeing sprint backlogs with Confluence and Jira, and managing source with GitLab
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithms · C# · C++ · Multithreading · Socket Programming · XAML · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Software Development
